page.$description: App background. Use behind everything. Not for cards or panels: use bg/surface.

surface.$description: Raised surfaces: cards, popovers, dialogs, composer. Not for page background.

inset.$description: Recessed areas such as code blocks. Sits below the page in dark, a shade under it in light.

subtle.$description: Quiet fills for muted blocks, tags, skeletons. Not for interactive hover: use bg/hover.

hover.$description: Hover and selected fill for list items and menu rows.

scrim.$description: Overlay behind modals and sheets. Always pair with text/on-scrim.

primary.$description: Default text and icons. Use on bg/page, surface, inset, sidebar, subtle and hover.

secondary.$description: Supporting text: captions, hints, metadata. Not for disabled state.

on-scrim.$description: Text and icons placed on bg/scrim, e.g. image lightbox controls.

default.$description: Decorative dividers and card outlines. Below 3:1 by design: do not use for input outlines.

strong.$description: Borders that identify a control (inputs, checkboxes). Meets 3:1 on page and surface.

ring.$description: Keyboard focus indicator. Meets 3:1 on page and surface in both themes.

bg.$description: Fill of the primary call to action. Pair with action/primary/fg.
Fill of secondary buttons. Text on it is text/primary.

fg.$description: Error text and icons. Not for destructive fills.

bg-subtle.$description: Background of error banners and inline error blocks. Pair with feedback/error/fg.
